description_en: Queries the information about a single NAT CIDR block of a VPC NAT gateway
description_zh: 调用GetNatIpCidrAttribute接口查询VPC NAT网关单个NAT IP地址段信息
name: GetNatIpCidrAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway instance to which the NAT IP address block belongs.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的 NAT IP 地址段所属 NAT 网关实例的地域 ID。

您可以通过调用 DescribeRegions 接口获取地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The NAT IP address block to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 NAT IP 地址段
parameters.name: nat_ip_cidr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the permissions of the RAM user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求。检查项包括 AccessKey 是否有效、RAM 用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP 状态码
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC NAT gateway instance to which the NAT IP address block belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的 NAT IP 地址段所属的 VPC NAT 网关实例 ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id
